candidate_lineage_rule: candidate row count, path-digest multiset, and all four snapshot IDs match EVALUATION_EVENT
episode_rule: at least 2 consecutive PLAN_PRIMARY STRICT no-candidate callbacks in one source epoch
localization_temporal_rule: abs nearest pose offset <=25 ms and pose sample gap <=50 ms; LOC_UNKNOWN retained
waypoint0_rule: at least one returned production candidate has waypoint0 footprint margin >= -1e-9 m
